mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing demand in the economy, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economic activity picks up.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods following a sustained increase in HOUST, or if the correlation between HOUST growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over a 3-month period signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve due to increased economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over a 3-month period indicates a robust supply-side response to demand, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a strong demand environment with a tight labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a 3-month period signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to the robust employment data.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over a 3-month period signals a potential deflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates a slowdown in economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a strong demand environment with a tight labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases & UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of GDPC1 and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
